event: Nomadic Vedic storytellers known as 'Kathakars' recite epics and Puranas through mime, rhythmic footwork, and song in northern Indian temple courtyards.
source: Sangeet Natak Akademi - Historical Evolution of Kathak (https://sangeetnatak.gov.in/)

event: The Vaishnavite Bhakti movement infuses Kathak with devotional 'Raas Leela' enactments celebrating Radha and Krishna, developing the lyrical Gat Bhav and expressive eye movements.
source: Sahapedia - Kathak and the Bhakti Movement (https://www.sahapedia.org/kathak-bhakti)

event: Under the patronage of Nawab Wajid Ali Shah and court maestro Thakur Prasad Maharaj, the Lucknow Gharana is codified, introducing swift chakkars (pirouettes), intricate tatkar, and courtly Thumri abhinaya.

Post-independence revival championed by Madame Menaka, Shambhu Maharaj, and the creation of the National Institute of Kathak Dance (Kathak Kendra) in New Delhi, taking classical dance to national auditoriums.
Preservation through AI motion analysis, spatial audio archiving, and open cultural provenance on ShilpSetu, bridging generational gharana masters to global learners.
source: Ministry of Culture - National Cultural Audiovisual Archives (https://ncaa.gov.in/)
